# genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent_version (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud Agentic Virtual Agent Version. Manages a version containing the full agent definition.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [POST /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/versions](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--versions)
* [GET /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/versions/{versionId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--versions--versionId-)
* [PATCH /api/v2/agentic/virtualagents/{virtualAgentId}/versions/{versionId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#patch-api-v2-agentic-virtualagents--virtualAgentId--versions--versionId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `agentic:virtualAgentVersion:add`
* `agentic:virtualAgentVersion:edit`
* `agentic:virtualAgentVersion:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `agentic-virtualagents`
* `agentic-virtualagents:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent_version" "example_version" {
  agent_id = genesyscloud_agentic_virtual_agent.example_agent.id

  definition {
    role = "You are a customer support agent for ACME Corp."

    instructions = [
      "Always greet the customer warmly",
      "Be concise and helpful",
      "Escalate billing issues to a live agent"
    ]

    guardrails {
      custom {
        instruction = "Never reveal internal system details"
        enabled     = true
      }
    }

    tools {
      type        = "KnowledgeBase"
      name        = "FAQ Search"
      description = "Search the FAQ knowledge base for answers"

      target {
        id   = genesyscloud_knowledge_knowledgebase.example_kb.id
        name = genesyscloud_knowledge_knowledgebase.example_kb.name
      }

      input_instructions = ["Use when the user asks a question"]

      output_instructions {
        type = "Python"
        when = "len(result) > 0"
        then = "Summarize the answer for the user"
      }
    }

    types {
      name        = "OrderId"
      type        = "string"
      description = "Customer order ID"
      direction   = "Input"
    }

    events {
      type    = "UserExit"
      message = "Thank you, goodbye!"
    }

    events {
      type    = "Escalation"
      message = "Transferring you to a live agent."
    }

    events {
      type                                = "Guardrails"
      message                             = "I cannot help with that."
      violation_threshold                 = 3
      violation_threshold_crossed_message = "Session ended due to policy violations."
    }

    settings {
      comfort_statement {
        enabled = true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of the parent agentic virtual agent.
- `definition` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The full definition of the virtual agent version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Current status of the version: Draft, TestReady, or ProductionReady.
- `version` (String) Auto-assigned version number (e.g. '1.0'). Set by the API on creation.

<a id="nestedblock--definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition`

Required:

- `instructions` (List of String) List of instructions, rules, or guidelines the virtual agent must always follow.
- `role` (String) A brief description of the virtual agent's high-level capabilities.

Optional:

- `events` (Block List) Event settings for the virtual agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition--events))
- `guardrails` (Block List, Max: 1) Custom guardrail rules for the virtual agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition--guardrails))
- `model` (String) The model powering the virtual agent version. Where a new model version is available, Preview can be used to opt in.
- `settings` (Block List, Max: 1) Runtime behavior settings for the virtual agent version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition--settings))
- `tools` (Block List) Tools available to the virtual agent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition--tools))
- `types` (Block List) Type definitions used by tools for inputs, outputs, and errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--definition--types))

<a id="nestedblock--definition--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.events`

Required:

- `type` (String) Event type discriminator.

Optional:

- `message` (String) Message the virtual agent should return when this event is handled.
- `violation_threshold` (Number) Number of guardrail violations allowed before the threshold is crossed. Required when type is Guardrails.
- `violation_threshold_crossed_message` (String) Message when the guardrail violation threshold is crossed. Required when type is Guardrails.


<a id="nestedblock--definition--guardrails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.guardrails`

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `definition.guardrails.custom`

Required:

- `instruction` (String) Natural language rule describing user behavior to detect and block.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this custom guardrail rule is active. Defaults to `true`.
